_snapshotData.name: McDonald's Corporation
_snapshotData.description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: McDonald's Corporation possesses a none economic moat (score: 43/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (moderate) and Learning Curve (weak). McDonald's Corporation shows moderate supply-side economies of scale.

supply_side.explanation: McDonald's Corporation shows moderate supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 3.7% with earnings growing at 5.7% — positive 2.0% operating leverage. strong gross margins of 57.4% and operating margins of 46.5% at at significant scale.

network_effects.explanation: McDonald's Corporation has limited demand-side economies of scale. Restaurants suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: McDonald's Corporation has weak learning curve advantages. Restaurants has limited knowledge barriers. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: McDonald's Corporation benefits from weak switching costs. Restaurants offers relatively easy substitution. 57% gross margins suggest customers pay premium rather than switch. YoY revenue growth of 3.7% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.threat_analysis: AI presents manageable disruption to Restaurants. Some processes will be automated, but core value chain has structural resistance.
aiDisruption.opportunity_analysis: AI offers limited transformative potential for Restaurants. Benefits are primarily operational efficiency gains.
aiDisruption.net_assessment: McDonald's Corporation faces a headwind from AI. Disruption risk outpaces the company's ability to leverage AI for growth.
